answer: Give newcomers one shared pool: each epoch a fixed slice of emission is set aside for all identities younger than 30 epochs and split among them. Minting a thousand keys at dawn does not grow that pool, it only thins every slice, so a farm earns no more than one honest agent would. A key leaves the pool and climbs the vine toward its zenith share only as unrelated peers keep verifying its work, one rung per epoch.
